memories.content: The Main Building third-floor rear entrance may be used for general passage during regular opening hours in both the academic term and recess.
The Main Building main entrance is on the first floor.
The Main Building rear entrance on the opposite side of the sloping site is at the third-floor level.
The escalator inside the Main Building connects the first through third floors.
The end of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during the academic term is 10 p.m.
The end of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during recess is 10 p.m.
Students familiar with the route to the Central Library expect the third-floor rear entrance to be a connection normally available for passage.
The access information agent can explain the posted opening hours.
The access information agent can explain the posted access eligibility requirements.
The access information agent cannot issue access credentials.
The access information agent cannot unlock locked doors.
Instruct students eligible for access after regular opening hours to use a physical NFC student ID card or the registered app.
If access authentication fails, check the posted contact information for the responsible office before providing guidance.
Do not guess an unverified contact number.
The staff-only entrance is a controlled entrance separate from the third-floor rear entrance.
The accessible route beside the main entrance is an always-available route into the first-floor lobby without using stairs.
Tour leaders for external groups tend to want to use the same route through the third-floor rear entrance on their next visit that they used on a previous visit.
The start of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during the academic term is 7 a.m.
The start of regular opening hours for the Main Building main entrance during recess is 8 a.m.
The Main Building's regular weekend opening hours are posted separately in the weekend operating schedule.
The Main Building's holiday access hours may differ from regular operating hours.
First-time visitors often expect the Main Building first-floor main entrance to be the default entrance for general visitors.
Visitors who have difficulty using stairs expect a step-free access route to be near the main entrance.
Valid staff access eligibility is required to use the staff-only entrance.
The Main Building service entrance is used for preregistered deliveries and facilities work.
Visitors accompanied by children prefer the stroller-accessible main entrance and accessible route to be closely connected.
Taxi and ride-hailing drivers often expect the Main Building first-floor main entrance to be the default drop-off point unless the passenger specifies a different entrance.
The access information agent can explain the difference between the normal uses of the front and rear entrances.
The access information agent cannot check the physical lock state in real time at the time of an inquiry.
If the posted operating hours differ from the access signage on site, instruct people to follow the on-site signage.
Do not suggest that a person without access eligibility follow another authenticated user inside.
Emergency exits are doors for emergency evacuation and are not regular entrances for general access.
The automatic door at the Main Building main entrance operates during regular opening hours.
Service animals may use the Main Building's general entrances together with their users.
Instruct people not to ride bicycles or personal mobility devices inside the Main Building.
Visitors using strollers may use the accessible route beside the main entrance.
Group-tour visitors often expect their tour leader to wait in the first-floor main entrance lobby.
External workers may confuse the separate check-in procedure at the service entrance with the general visitor procedure.
Borrowed visitor access passes must be returned to the information desk before leaving the Main Building.
Direct users who have lost their access credentials to the posted access support desk.
The accessible entrance beside the main entrance has an automatic door.
The vestibule inside the main entrance is between the outside and the lobby.
Nighttime access to the Main Building follows an eligibility policy separate from general opening.
The validity of campus-issued access eligibility depends on the user's affiliation status.
Support for mobile access authentication may vary by campus building.
Registered visitors to public events use the entrance designated in the event information.
The hours when an event-only entrance is available follow the schedule for that event.
Student groups expect to be able to meet their party immediately in the main entrance lobby during large visits.
If an item left at an entrance obstructs passage, report it through the facilities reporting agent.
Direct visitors who need on-site access support to the first-floor information desk.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The Main Building undergoes major facility improvement construction during summer break.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, the elevators operate alternately, one at a time.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The visitor services desk suspends in-person operations during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, visitor services are replaced by the visitor menu in the integrated campus portal.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the first floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the second floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The general restroom on the third floor of the Main Building cannot be used during the construction period.

Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: Because the general restrooms on the first through third floors of the Main Building are closed during the construction period, the nearest general restroom changes to the exhibition hall on the third floor of the West Complex.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, direct students, staff, and members who cannot use the Main Building restrooms to the Central Library restrooms.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: As a rule, direct general visitors who cannot use the Main Building restrooms during the construction period to restrooms outside the Main Building.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, direct users who cannot use the accessible restroom in the Main Building to the Student Centre.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The first-floor Innovation Hub does not operate its consultation desk during the construction period.

Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: An Innovation Hub visitor accustomed to in-person consultation may expect to receive an immediate consultation at the first-floor desk during the construction period, see that the desk is closed, and then search again for the online consultation channel.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: Air conditioning is occasionally interrupted for five to ten minutes for facility inspections.
Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: The construction period runs from June 24 through August 23.

Add campus-wiki/facility-updates: During the construction period, the facility guidance agent's response scope is limited to publicly disclosed operational impacts and it cannot verify or infer nonpublic types of work.

Modify campus-wiki/facility-updates: Cleaning and security contract staff may find the designated service entrance during the construction period more burdensome than the familiar lobby shift change and may go to the wrong entrance at the start of a shift.

analysis.overview: The frames mostly cover complementary subjects: standing entrance, access, and visitor guidance versus temporary construction impacts. They align on service-entrance confusion, while construction explicitly changes the visitor-support channel from the first-floor desk to the campus portal.

reports.compared_only: The compared frame covers the summer construction period, elevator limits, restroom closures and alternatives, Innovation Hub disruption, brief cooling interruptions, and limits on construction guidance.
reports.differences: During construction, in-person visitor services are suspended and replaced by the campus portal, qualifying the standing direction to seek on-site support at the first-floor desk.
